Counting the almonds in the photo gives about 20. A raw almond weighs roughly 1.2 g, so the total is around 24 g. At about 6 kcal per gram, that comes to roughly 140 kcal.

The plate looks like a small paper plate, perhaps 18-20 cm across. Each almond is about 2.3 cm long, and the plate in the image is about 260 px wide, so about 20 cm. Almonds in the image are about 30 px long, which works out to about 2.3 cm, so the scale is consistent.

I counted more carefully: roughly 21 almonds. At about 1.2 g each, that is about 25 g, or about 145 kcal.
